label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verse: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
note: From the psalm David gave when the ark came to Jerusalem — it reappears almost word for word in Psalm 96.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free _____.
verse: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
note: Freedom from the Son isn't a technicality or a trial run — it's 'free indeed.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a _____, and cried out:
verse: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
note: Modern versions say 'ghost'; the KJV says the terrified disciples supposed Jesus walking on the sea was a spirit.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a _____ before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verse: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
note: Don't trip the blind or curse the deaf: the Law protects even people who'd never know who did it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thou, O LORD, _____ for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verse: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
note: Lamentations ends among ruins, but this verse stands: 'Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.'
